question: Сколько всего задач в системе?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_issues FROM issues;

question: Сколько открытых задач?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as open_issues FROM issues WHERE status NOT IN ('Закрыта', 'Отклонена');

question: Сколько задач создано пользователем Иванов?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues WHERE author_name ILIKE '%Иванов%';

question: Какие задачи созданы на этой неделе?
sql: SELECT id, subject, created_on FROM issues WHERE created_on >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY created_on DESC;

question: Сколько задач в каждом проекте?
sql: SELECT project_name, COUNT(id) as issue_count FROM issues GROUP BY project_name ORDER BY issue_count DESC;

question: Какие задачи имеют наивысший приоритет?
sql: SELECT id, subject, priority FROM issues WHERE priority = 'Высокий' ORDER BY created_on DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Кто создал больше всего задач?
sql: SELECT author_name, COUNT(id) as issues_count FROM issues GROUP BY author_name ORDER BY issues_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Найти задачи с словом 'баг' в описании
sql: SELECT id, subject, description FROM issues WHERE description ILIKE '%баг%' OR subject ILIKE '%баг%' LIMIT 20;

question: Показать последние 10 созданных задач
sql: SELECT id, subject, project_name, created_on FROM issues ORDER BY created_on DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Какие открытые задачи в проекте eily.acuario?
sql: SELECT id, subject, status, created_on FROM issues WHERE project_name = 'eily.acuario' AND status NOT IN ('Закрыта', 'Отклонена') ORDER BY created_on DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Какие открытые задачи в проекте eily.acuario?
sql: SELECT id, subject, status, created_on FROM issues WHERE (project_name ILIKE '%eily.acuario%' OR project_name ILIKE '%eily%') AND is_closed = false ORDER BY created_on DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Показать последние 10 созданных задач в проекте
sql: SELECT id, subject, project_name, created_on FROM issues WHERE project_name ILIKE '%{название проекта}%' ORDER BY created_on DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Сколько открытых задач в конкретном проекте?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as open_issues FROM issues WHERE project_name ILIKE '%{название проекта}%' AND is_closed = false;

question: Найти все подзадачи задачи 17797
sql: SELECT ir.relation_type, i.id, i.subject, i.status, i.is_closed FROM issue_relations ir JOIN issues i ON ir.issue_to_id = i.id WHERE ir.issue_id = 17797 AND ir.relation_type IN ('relates', 'blocks', 'precedes', 'follows', 'blocks', 'duplicates') ORDER BY i.created_on DESC;

question: Найти открытые подзадачи задачи
sql: SELECT ir.relation_type, i.id, i.subject, i.status, i.project_name FROM issue_relations ir JOIN issues i ON ir.issue_to_id = i.id WHERE ir.issue_id = {issue_id} AND i.is_closed = false ORDER BY i.created_on DESC;

question: Показать связи задачи с другими задачами
sql: SELECT ir.relation_type, i.id as related_issue_id, i.subject, i.status, i.project_name FROM issue_relations ir JOIN issues i ON ir.issue_to_id = i.id WHERE ir.issue_id = {issue_id} ORDER BY ir.relation_type, i.created_on DESC;
